title: Website Design & Development
intro: Create a useful digital experience that helps people understand your offer and take the next step.
audience: For businesses building a new website, improving an existing customer journey or bringing their digital presence in line with a changing offer.
audiencePoints: Startups launching a clear first digital home
Established teams planning a site refresh or new section
deliverables: A review of the business goals, audiences, content and key paths through the site.
Page flows, wireframes and a visual system for the agreed experience.
Responsive, accessible front-end implementation with carefully organised content and assets.
Content checks, browser review and handover notes for the delivered pages.
process: Clarify the audience, content needs and role of the website.
Set the page structure and prioritise the journeys that matter.
Create the interface and develop the approved pages with regular review.
Check responsive states, content and links before handover.
faqs: Can you redesign an existing website?
Yes. We can review the current content and journeys, then agree which parts should be retained, improved or rebuilt.
Content structure and page messaging can be included in the scope. Final facts, claims and approvals come from the client.
Will the website work on mobile?
Responsive behavior is included in the design and front-end review for the agreed page templates and screen sizes.
